items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Mill and Boyd, you go the same way... It was always packed and they run every fifteen minutes but still you couldn't get on that train.

ctx.x: No, I've heard other people, they all got that too out of the lake.

We would go to Canal Street here to catch the Spanish Pro train and if I had to get out there for eight o'clock to play, I'd leave six o'clock in the morning to try to get on that train because I would not get out to the lake two hours ahead of time because they had more drums and basses in their baggage, a whole car full of them and some had to put them in front, some that can't catch that train, catch the next one. Mill and Boyd, you go the same way. In the vision field. Yeah, the same way. It was always packed…
